newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-July fixed asset investment up 10.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-July fixed asset investment up 10.5 pct.

text.p: China's fixed asset investment rose 10.5 percent year-on-year from January to July, down 3.0 percentage points compared with growth in the first half, the Economic Daily said on Monday.
The fall in fixed asset investment growth was due to the holiday season and delays in investment reaching target projects, the newspaper said without giving details.
Investment in capital construction and renovation grew 14.9 percent from January to July after adjusting for seasonal factors, it said.
Fixed asset investment for the entire year was expected to rise 12.7 percent, economists have said.
